map.巴西 CPF 共 11 位,前 9 位为基,第 10、11 位为校验位,采用模: Brazil CPF has 11 digits: the first 9 are the base, digits 10 and 11 are check digits, using the mod-11 algorithm:
map.第 10 位:前 9 位分别乘 10→2 求和,取模 11;余 0 或 1 则第: Digit 10: multiply the first 9 by 10→2, sum, mod 11; if remainder is 0 or 1, digit 10 = 0, else = 11 − remainder.
map.第 11 位:前 10 位乘 11→2 求第 11 位,规则同上。: Digit 11: multiply the first 10 by 11→2 to get digit 11; same rule.
map.⚠️ 仅校验号码格式,不验证 CPF 是否真实存在或有效。: ⚠️ Only validates the number format; does not verify whether the CPF truly exists or is valid.
map.校验 11 位 CPF 的两位 mod 11 校验位: Validate the two mod-11 check digits of an 11-digit CPF
map.巴西客户建档、KYC 前核对个人税号: Verify the personal tax number before Brazilian customer onboarding / KYC
map.识别 CPF 手输或 OCR 笔误: Catch manual-entry or OCR errors in CPF
map.输入 52998224725 显示校验通过；把最后一位改成 6 得到 52998: Enter 52998224725 → validation passes; change the last digit to 6 to get 52998224726 and the second check digit fails.
map.CPF 校验位怎么算？: How are CPF check digits computed?
map.前 9 位按权重 10..2 加权求和，(和×10) mod 11 得第 1 位: First 9 weighted by 10..2, (sum×10) mod 11 gives check digit 1; then use the 10 digits weighted 11..2 to recompute digit 2; remainder 10 is recorded as 0.
map.CPF 通过校验就有效吗？: Is a CPF valid just because it passes?
map.不代表。页面只校验结构与校验位，个人是否真实注册须在官方系统核对。: No. The page only checks structure and check digits; whether the person is really registered must be verified in the official system.
map.为什么提示长度或字符错误？: Why does it report a length or character error?
map.CPF 须为 11 位数字，输入可带 . 与 - 分组符，页面会先清理；含字母或: CPF must be 11 digits; input may include . and - separators, which the page cleans first; letters or insufficient length are flagged as format errors.
map.巴西 CPF 验证。巴西 CPF 验证器。输入 11 位个人税号，按模 11 算: Brazil CPF validation. Brazil CPF validator. Enter the 11-digit personal tax number; validate format and the two check digits by the mod-11 algorithm, for identity-verification number legality checks (not a validity check).
